title: A WebSocket frame says how long it is in 7 bits, and in 16 more when 7 are not enough
caption: A frame from a client carrying 126 to 65,535 bytes (RFC 6455, section 5.2). The 7-bit length holds 126, which means the real length follows in the next 16 bits. The mask bit is set, so a 4-byte masking key comes before the payload.
